text:
oncall-bot: PAGER — GPU OOM during streaming decode detected. Severity: P1. Service: runtime-decode-prod. Node: gpu-a12.zone1. Container: decode-5b2a.
ryan.j: picking this up. I see memory ramp on the decode worker correlating with a few long-running streaming sessions.
maya.k: logs show repeated "CUDA out of memory" inside the attention KV write, process killed by OOM killer, container restarting.
engineer-bot: note: deploy deploy-20260301-1145 introduced a change that removed the enforcement of server-side token limits. Suspect regression.
alex.p: customer-facing impact: estimated ~420 failed stream requests in the last 12m, top-affected route: /v1/stream/generate.
nina.s: collecting top API keys by error volume now.
ryan.j: sample error from logs:
```
2026-03-01T11:42:07Z ERROR decode::loop: cuda runtime error (out of memory) while allocating 6144MB, free 512MB
at decode::generate -> kv_cache::append -> cudaMalloc
```
maya.k: I can reproduce locally with a streaming request that never caps; client sent `max_tokens=50000` and the model kept churning tokens until OOM.
ryan.j: mitigation steps: 1) flip runtime token enforcement back on 2) throttle the top offending API keys 3) cordon/drain the OOM node 4) scale pool briefly while throttling 5) rollback the deploy if needed.
nina.s: flagged API key `sk-prod-omega-77` responsible for ~33% of spike traffic. Reaching out to tenant success.
maya.k: applying runtime cap via control-plane:
```
curl -X POST "https://control-plane.internal/api/runtime/config" \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN_TOKEN\" \
  -d '{\"max_token_enforce\":\"true\",\"max_tokens_global\":\"4096\"}'
```
engineer-bot: control-plane accepted change, config pushed to decode-pool-3.
alex.p: temporarily throttle api key `sk-prod-omega-77` to 30r/min.
ryan.j: scale up pool to absorb rescheduled containers: `kubectl scale deploy decode-worker -n prod --replicas=14`.
ops-bot: cordoning node gpu-a12: `kubectl cordon gpu-a12` then draining: `kubectl drain gpu-a12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data`.
engineer-bot: node drained, pods rescheduled to gpu-b03 and gpu-b04.
nina.s: after caps + throttles error rate fell from 3.8% to 0.5% in 8 minutes. Memory metrics stable.
ryan.j: initiating rollback of deploy-20260301-1145: `deployctl rollback runtime-config deploy-20260301-1145`.
maya.k: confirmed enforcement active, requests over 4096 tokens now return 400 `max_tokens_exceeded` or are truncated depending on client flags.
cust-success: initial customer notice drafted and sent to top impacted tenants. Will follow up with RCA.
ryan.j: short-term followups: add per-key token-rate alert, hard cap in decode loop at 10k tokens to prevent runaway, and add integration test preventing disabling server-side cap.
alex.p: assigning postmortem lead: @alex.p. Target: initial draft by EOD next Friday.
nina.s: created incident channel for communications and pinned mitigation commands.
oncall-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE — status: mitigated. Severity lowered to P3. Monitor for 2 hours. Acknowledge.
